rules.alternatives: CE is optional: the 40 CE hours are one of five ways to show continuing competency, and any one within the past 2 years is enough: 400 hours of active nursing practice as an RN or LPN/VN (paid, unpaid or volunteer), passing the NCLEX, a Board-accepted refresher course, or a nursing degree program beyond the basic nursing education.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees first licensed in a renewal year must still renew that year.
rules.notes: All licenses renew every even calendar year, Oct 1 to Dec 31. Proof of competency (e.g. CE certificates or practice hours) is submitted with the renewal application. The Board's FAQ says Wyoming has no mandatory CE and calls CE an optional competency. The Board states fees are waived for the 2026 renewal; $90 is the listed fee plus a 2.4% card fee.
rules.legal_basis: W.S. §33-21-129 (Nurse Practice Act); WSBN Rules Chapter 2, Section 14
rules.rule_quote: (d) RN/LPN/VN. (i) An RN or LPN/VN shall demonstrate continuing competency by completing one of the following in the past two (2) years: (A) Four hundred (400) hours of active nursing practice; or (B) Successfully pass the NCLEX; or (C) Complete a refresher course or the equivalent, accepted by the Board; or (D) Complete a nursing education program that confers a degree beyond the applicant's basic nursing education; or (E) Submit evidence of forty (40) hours of continuing education.
